messages:
Ava Park: Quick sync — I'm drafting the SI proctoring runbook for Q3 drop-in labs. Goal: one-page checklist for partners + logistics for proctored certs. Sharing initial questions. 

Jamal Khan: Nice. Do we have a recommended proctoring vendor? Or do partners run locally? 

Priya Shah: We piloted ProctorHub with EdgeWave last month. Lightweight API, supports webcam + screen capture, SOC2 ok. Would recommend as default but allow local SI-run option if they sign attestation. 

Ben Ortiz: For the labs that require GPU HW, we need a shipping window. Can we give SIs a 6-week lead for hardware? 

Sophie Lee: 6-week lead time is realistic for the HW partners. For cloud VMs we can provide a marketplace AMI and a bootstrap script. I'll attach the bootstrap snippet below.

Sophie Lee: ```bash
#!/bin/bash
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y docker
curl -o start.sh https://redwood-inference.example/si-lab/start.sh
bash start.sh --role=proctor
``` 

Jamal Khan: Nice. Can we standardize the exam duration and pass criteria? We should have single config: 90 minutes, 70% pass. 

Ava Park: Agree. 90m and 70% pass. Also need clear retake policy and proctor logs retention (90 days). 

Priya Shah: For compliance, proctor logs must be encrypted at rest and accessible only to Redwood + SI admin. We'll add KMS reference. 

Ben Ortiz: Lab image versions — we should pin to runtime v1.4.2 for the pilot. Ops can publish a signed checksum. 

Ava Park: Action items: 1) Priya — draft vendor attestation template (due 1756200000). 2) Sophie — publish bootstraps + AMI with checksums (due 1756150000). 3) Ben — confirm HW partner shipping SLA (due 1756180000). 4) Jamal — write exam rubric and question pool (due 1756190000). 

Ava Park: Also thinking of a partner-facing one-pager: 'How to run a proctored SI certification' — short checklist + timeline. Who can take lead? 

Sophie Lee: I'll draft the one-pager. Keep it 1 page, focused on the runbook + contact points. 

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: "SI Proctor Runbook Kickoff" — https://calendar.example/event/abc123 (Tue 10am PT) :calendar:

Jamal Khan: Quick Q — are we allowing recording of sessions for training? If yes, need consent language. 

Priya Shah: Yes but only with explicit candidate consent. Add a checkbox in the exam flow and a consent paragraph in the partner SLA. 

Ava Park: Great, let's keep momentum. I'll consolidate notes into a draft runbook this week and post in #partnerships for review. :rocket:

Ben Ortiz: LGTM. Also noting: include fallback paths if proctoring service degrades (e.g., supervised in-person option). 

Sophie Lee: Adding that. 

Ava Park: Thanks team — will ping reviewers when draft is up.
